description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure and a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain one life.
Repeat.
